evs.text: Long ago, on the Island of Sounds, there grew a magic World Flower.
Every petal was a sound. With sounds, we could talk, and read, and sing!
Words, words, WORDS! How I HATE them!
I am Baron Muddle! Every sound on this island is MINE! Mwa-ha-ha-ha!
Oh no! The petals blew away, all over the island!
The World Flower has gone dark. Now nobody can read!
We need a hero. We need... a Super Ninja!
Win back every petal, one sound at a time!
I am Sensei Maple. I will train you. Now, choose your ninja!
Do you go to big school yet?
Then I've set up some listening games, just for you!
Your grown-ups can change this later, in the grown-ups' settings.
Ninja training! First, tap the big gong!
Stuck? Tap me, down here in the corner. Try it now!
That's it! I'm always here to help.
And when you tap the speaker, I'll say it again!
And when you tap the speaker, I'll say it again!
Ninja ears on! Let's listen to some words.
I can say a word fast. Sun!
Or I can say it slowly...
Fast or slow, it's the same word. Sun!
Slowly, I hear its sounds. Words are made of sounds!
Now you tap the tortoise, and say it slowly with me.
Now tap the rabbit, and say it fast.
Listen to the very first sound.
Sun and sock start with the same sound...
Tap all the pictures that start with...
You found them both! They both start with...
You can hear the sounds in words. Brilliant listening!
Look! Your pictures are turning into stickers!
Sun, sock, cat, sausage and moon!
Every picture you play with becomes a sticker!
Ready for the next game? Tap the big arrow!
Your turn! Tap them the ninja way.
Listen. Cat... dog. Which one did I read?
Two little words can make one big word!
Say them slowly: sun... flower. Say them fast: sunflower!
Star... fish. Tap the rabbit, and say them fast.
You read the pictures, just like a real reader!
Fish, dog, flower, sunflower, star and starfish!
Ooh, a shiny sticker! Fish dog!
Sun, sock, sausage and sunflower. They all start with...

Inside each petal are shiny gems. Each gem is a way to spell the sound.
When you play and get it right, a gem fills up with ninja power.
When a gem is full, it glows. Then you can win it in a gem battle!
Win all the gems in a petal, and the petal flies back onto the World Flower!

Story time! I'll read, and you read too.
In Bamboo Village, the pandas were having a terrible day. Baron Muddle had pinched their lunch pot and hidden it! But Super Ninja had a clue...
The map showed a twisty path, deep into the bamboo. Super Ninja crept along, quiet as a mouse.
Two places to look! Where is the pot hidden?
Read the two words. Tap the one you choose.
The pandas cheered and gobbled up every last dumpling. And look! Inside the pot was a glowing sound petal.
Tap the glowing stone to start your next adventure.
So... a little ninja wants to stop me? My sumo panda will squash you!
A big boss monster! Listen carefully, and spell your best!
Muddle... muddle... muddle. Your sounds belong to ME now!
Grrrr... You dare to fight ME?
Nooo! My muddle! This is not over, ninja... I will be back!
You beat the boss! What a ninja!
